ai_summary: **Executive Summary:**  Mr. Sandeep Gupta, a promoter of Asian Hotels (West) Limited, has increased his direct shareholding by 1.72% (200,000 shares) through an inter-se gift from Vinita Gupta, raising his stake from 16.32% to 18.04% without triggering an open offer. This transaction consolidates ownership within the promoter group, as it is an exempt transfer among immediate relatives. A notable red flag is the reporting of future-dated acquisition and disclosure dates (September 2026) within a document seemingly filed in October 202x, suggesting a potential error or unusual forward-looking reporting.
